name: cortex-local-memory
description: Local-first memory for Claude. One 33 MB Go binary, hybrid BM25 + vector retrieval in ~50 ms, no cloud, no Docker.
long_description: Cortex indexes your notes, docs and code on device and returns ranked ~512-token passages instead of file paths. Hybrid search (BM25 + vector), incremental re-index, MCP stdio server. Free tier: 20,000 documents / 4 GiB. The bundle ships a small launcher that downloads the matching release binary on first run and verifies its SHA256.
